notes.title: Chapter 3: The Enchanted Forest, released today!
notes.content:
[b]Chapter 3: The Enchanted Forest.[/b]

Chapter 3 introduces new content to Opaloid Kingdom, including achievements, levels, enemies, abilities, and a new storyline featuring the Azure Sorcerer. You'll be able to access it from Zone 61.

After escaping the Crazy Wizard's fortress, the Azure Sorcerer discovers that his journey home will be more challenging than expected. The forest has been poisoned by the alchemical experiments of the Crazy Wizard, leaving it filled with aggressive, viscous, and poisonous creatures. The only way to help the inhabitants of the forest is to explore the ancient Emerald Temple, located in the heart of the forest, and recover the Whirpool Amulet.

Changes and fixes:

- New attack patterns for the Azure Sorcerer.
- New zones and achievements from Zone 61 onwards. 
- Removed an NPC from Zone 1
- Added coin to Zone 2.
- Zone 3 map has a narrower path to Zone 4.
- Zone 4 balance changes.
- Zone 5 layout changes. 
- Fixed Soldier and NPC pathing in Zone 11.
- Balance changes to Zone 22.
- Balance changes to Zone 26, famous for its difficulty.
- Removed a coin object that had no functionality in Zone 26.
- Balance changes to Zone 27.
- Balance changes to zone 41, 43.
- Zone 46 is now substantially easier.
- Zone 49 has fewer soldiers.
- Lava boulder's damage is now 2.


With the release of chapter 3, Opaloid Kingdom is leaving Early Access! We will continue to make balance updates based on your feedback about the new zones.

Please report any bugs you encounter on our Twitter (@OpaloidKingdom), Instagram (@Opaloid_Kingdom), or on the Steam forums. Thank you!

notes.title: New Extra HP Item, UI changes and zone balance.
notes.content:
New - Extra HP Item - added! The Sorcerer and the Wizard can now get extra permanent hit points, the special item is available in certain zones, starting in zone 19 and 39.

Current health and maximum health points are now permanently displayed on the screen.

Crazy Wizard's starting HP is now 4, including the ship in zone 34.

Mushroom item effect now lasts 20 seconds but its effects carry on to other zones if the timer hasn't expired.

Mushroom item added to zone 6 and 59.

Giant rat removed from zone 27.

Balance changes to zone 15.

Removed randomness from lava boulder spawners from zone 40 and upwards to improve speedrunning.

As always please report any bugs you encounter either on twitter or the game's Steam forums and prepare for Chapter 3 which is coming soon!

notes.title: Balance changes, mushroom visual fx and new achievement.
notes.content:
